name: Episode Generator
description: Causal story engine + motion-comic video output. Builds a season from one of 30 narrative archetype presets (Hero's Journey, Tragedy, Heist, Whodunit, Siege, Revenge, Betrayal, Locked Room, Coming of Age, and more), each a contract binding want, obstacle, climax and resolution so the parts cohere. Every episode runs a 9-beat dramatic spine (ordinary world -> inciting incident -> commitment -> first obstacle -> midpoint reversal -> escalation -> crisis -> climax -> resolution) against a StoryLedger that tracks what the protagonist knows, holds, owes and has lost, so scenes reference each other causally and threads carry between episodes. Location, time and weather are continuous. Includes a from-scratch Scene Builder with live art generation, and renders any episode as a 1280x720 WebM with animated portraits, camera motion and a procedural ambient score.
